summary: Frontend-only retest of the three iteration_4 fixes passed on the public URL. Verified single-entry and legacy labels, 5-entry totals across Home/Schedule/saved-month badge, the 44x44 mobile remove target with centered icon, and add/save/reopen/remove/delete-day regression flows. Production build also compiled successfully.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested acceptance and regression scenarios passed

seed_data_creation: Browser-local localStorage only: seeded August 2026 with 5 activities across days 6, 15, and 16, including a legacy single-object day; used temporary September 2026 data for CRUD regression and deleted it at the end. No backend/shared data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_4 defects are resolved. Public URL returned HTTP 200 and yarn build passed. Verified Home summary '5 atividades cadastradas.', Schedule subtitle count 5, saved-month-2026-08 badge 5, 'Atividade 1 de 1' for array and legacy single-object days and after removing entry 2, plus a precisely 44x44px mobile remove target with centered icon and no horizontal overflow. Full multi-entry save/reopen/remove/delete-day regression passed.
rca_of_the_issue: The fixes correctly removed conditional ordinal rendering, changed count calculations to sum normalized entry-array lengths, and expanded the remove button using 44px minimum dimensions with flex centering. No unresolved defect was reproduced.
